scope: Bounded single-task versus mixed-task successful BC diagnosis, original Motus initialization; no critic or RL claim
initialization: Pinned original Motus weights and common seed0 residual adapter with zero output; never load W1 actor/addon. Frozen value head is unused.
sampling: Success-only, uniform episode then decision within each task. Fixed512-draw per-task streams, independent of job length. Mixed batch is2A+2B. Single-task batches are4 draws from the same per-task stream. Per-task occurrence identifies FM noise/time across all groups.

comparisons.same_total: a_only128 and b_only128 versus mixed128:512 supervised decisions each; mixed256 per task
comparisons.same_per_task: a_only64 and b_only64 versus mixed128: exactly the same256 per-task decisions and noise/time, different total compute/optimizer steps and task contribution to mean loss
comparisons.supplementary: mixed64 retained as a fixed curve point, never select best checkpoint

primary_evaluation: Original12 development scenes per task, every actor evaluated on both tasks, same original noise/checkers/backend; no validation-based checkpoint selection
limits: One actor seed and two development tasks. Neither budget comparison alone proves gradient direction conflict. Native worker adaptation is separate from full official RECAP baseline.
